verification.name: P40 Google Media Connection and Plan
P39 Autonomous Skills and Cinematic Web

safetyInvariants: normal users do not manually start specialist teams; request mediation creates or reuses the bounded team automatically for substantial work
Safe/Balanced/Autonomous controls permission policy, not whether specialist routing is automatic
dashboard agent state comes from current team phase composition/runtime activeAgents rather than legacy top-level fields
installed != loaded != utilized; installed skills are PC-wide/bundled, loaded skills are latest/current invocation guidance, utilized skills are durable project history
Auto Initialize bootstraps materializable skills once into the user-owned Dockyard library and later invocations load only selected verified skills
selected != installed != loaded != configured != authenticated != connected != approved
Connections may remember non-secret provider IDs after successful verification, but authentication is re-probed and stale readiness must not imply mutation approval
Google AI API keys are stored only in VS Code SecretStorage or provided via process environment and never written to Dockyard project/checkpoint state or sent to webviews
Google AI live readiness uses a bounded read-only models request and never logs the credential
Veo planning is billable-aware and hash-bound but execution remains disabled until a separate explicit billable execution gate is implemented
provider/MCP readiness never grants deployment, database, DNS, Git, destructive, production, or billable-media approval

treat verifiedCodeSha as the P40.1 completed production anchor and inspect newer production commits before work

preserve current-phase agent rendering and Installed/Loaded/Utilized skill truth
preserve SecretStorage/in-memory credential handling and never persist Google API keys in Dockyard state
